method_notes: Link records only. No image was downloaded and no HTTP request of any kind was made for these files — everything here is parsed from the manifest URLs.

Filename grammar (Bob's ORWW convention): <frame>_<Place_Slug>_<YYYYMMDD>-<size>.jpg, e.g. 0866_Buehner_Camp_20171010-10.jpg. The parser is deliberately tolerant: the trailing -N is stripped first, then any 8-digit date is taken from anywhere in the stem, then the leading 3-5 digit frame number, and whatever remains is the place slug.

The trailing -N is an ORWW SIZE code, not a sequence: -10 files sit in /Photos/ and are the display images; -2 (and two -7) files sit in /Photos/icons/ and are the thumbnails of the same frame. It is reported as seq (as asked) and as rendition.
Renditions of one frame are folded into a photograph record keyed on folder date + frame number + place slug; photos[] still lists every URL individually.
Many frames on 2017-11-08 and 2017-12-06 carry no place slug at all (e.g. 1487-10.jpg) — Bob left them unnamed. They are kept with place_slug null rather than guessed at.
rendition_note: ORWW convention: -10 is the display image, -2 (in icons/) the thumbnail.
